name: Agent root
responsibility: Holds the agent of a page over its panes and offers it to every surface drawn below: the owners, one setup, the voice session, the actions, the draft and the panel
description: The assembly apps/web made before TASK-653.13 (use-workbench, use-agent*, use-voice-view, the voice store, the owners, agent focus, the setup's ports, the subtitled transcript, the snapshot cache and the progress clock). The panes' conversations arrive by registration from AgentPane; the voice session stays with the pane voice was started from until it ends. The narrator starts voice once it has followed the pane a narration was asked for.
